name: Pog Runners
summary: Pog Runners is a social horror experience where you can run, play, and hang out with friends in creepy, unpredictable worlds. Explore spooky environments, test your reflexes in action-packed challenges, and show off your style as you chat and connect with other players. Whether you’re here to flex, survive, or just have fun, Pog Runners is a place where every run feels different — and every shadow might be hiding something.
